question: Does repeated ordered onset-group pitch content exceed the recurrence induced by the same pitch-group inventory in Cycle49 outputs?
scope: Exploratory reanalysis of all 36 observed Cycle49 outputs, not new training, generation, held-out evaluation or source admission.
representation: Each simultaneous onset is one sorted tuple of exact MIDI pitches, preserving multiplicity; chronological groups. No arbitrary within-chord note ordering. Rhythm, velocity, durations, harmony and perceived phrase identity are not measured.
metric: For all overlapping windows, (number of windows minus number of distinct windows)/number of windows. Fewer than w onset groups is explicitly ineligible.
control: 100 deterministic permutations of whole pitch-group tokens per output, shuffle seeds 51000..51099. Exact token inventory and group count preserved. Timing is not a control and permutations are not playable music or independent corpora.
report: All rows and eligible denominators; observed mean, permutation mean, descriptive difference. No p value, model choice, causal claim or attractiveness ranking. Post hoc hypothesis motivated by Cycle50.
verification: Require private source hashes equal Cycle49 ledger before/after. Unit tests and exact repeat except CPU; no raw generated notes in report.
